احونصلن (form IIIq)
# اِحْوَنْصَلْنَ (iḥwanṣalna) /iħ.wan.sˤal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْوَنْصَلَ (iḥwanṣala)
# اِحْوَنْصِلْنَ (iḥwanṣilna) /iħ.wan.sˤil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْوَنْصَلَ (iḥwanṣala)
